name: Circulating fluidized-bed boiler (CFB)
description: Solid-fuel boiler that burns particles in a circulating fluidized bed, recirculating the bed material through a cyclone so even difficult fuels — high-sulfur, high-ash, waste, biomass and refinery solids — burn cleanly at low furnace temperature with limestone capturing SOx in the furnace. Fluidized-bed steam generation for power and industrial steam where fuel flexibility and in-furnace desulfurization matter.

name: Electric and electrode steam boiler
description: Steam generator heated directly by electricity — resistance elements in a pressure vessel, or current conducted through the boiler water by electrodes at high voltage. No combustion, no flue gas and no fuel system, so it avoids the chimney, fuel infrastructure and air-permit scope entirely, and pairs with cheap or surplus site power; the electrification option for on-site steam.

name: Packaged fire-tube steam boiler
description: Shop-assembled shell boiler in which hot combustion gases pass through tubes surrounded by the water, typically in two to four passes with a reverse-flue turnaround. The standard packaged steam source for small and medium industrial loads and the workhorse of on-site utilities where steam demand runs from tens of thousands of pounds per hour downward.

name: Heat recovery steam generator (HRSG)
description: Boiler fired by hot combustion-turbine or furnace exhaust gas rather than by burners, raised in horizontal or vertical panels behind a gas turbine with one or more drum pressures and optionally reheat. Converts a gas turbine into a combined-cycle or cogeneration plant and is the deciding component for how much of the turbine exhaust energy becomes steam.
applications: site-wide cogeneration steam for refineries and petrochemical complexes
supplemental duct firing where peaks or steam demand require

specifications.basis: about 20% for two-pressure without reheat, 26% for three-pressure, about 30% for three-pressure with reheat

source.note: US EPA technical support document: efficient generation from combustion turbine EGUs, April 2024

name: Industrial water-tube package boiler
description: Shop-assembled watertube boiler (steam and lower drum above a water-cooled membrane furnace) custom-engineered per project, with D-type and O-type two-drum layouts.
